related.title: SG 14-222 DD 直驅離岸風機
related.titleEn: Siemens Gamesa SG 14-222 DD Offshore Wind Turbine
related.transfer: 可遷移「葉尖速與轉速」與「氣隙公差與結構剛度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；SG 14-222 DD 直驅離岸風機的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Tip speed and rotor speed" and "Air-gap tolerance and structural stiffness" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Siemens Gamesa SG 14-222 DD Offshore Wind Turbine must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦沒有齒輪箱的發電機：氣隙剪應力與扭矩、極數與頻率、永久磁鐵的用量與氣隙公差；SG 14-222 DD 直驅離岸風機則以直驅 14 MW 風機：機艙重量、在臺灣海峽的部署與葉片前緣的雨蝕為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A generator with no gearbox: air-gap shear stress and torque, poles and frequency, magnet quantity and air-gap tolerance; Siemens Gamesa SG 14-222 DD Offshore Wind Turbine centres on A direct-drive 14 MW turbine: nacelle weight, deployment in the Taiwan Strait and rain erosion of blade leading edges, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「掃掠面積與比功率」與「掃掠面積與比功率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「極數與輸出頻率」的模型移到SG 14-222 DD 直驅離岸風機，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「結構自然頻率與 1P、3P」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Swept area and specific power" and "Swept area and specific power".
Move the model of "Poles and output frequency" to Siemens Gamesa SG 14-222 DD Offshore Wind Turbine, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Structural natural frequency and 1P, 3P", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「葉尖速與轉速」與「氣隙公差與結構剛度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；SG 14-222 DD 直驅離岸風機的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Tip speed and rotor speed" and "Air-gap tolerance and structural stiffness" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Siemens Gamesa SG 14-222 DD Offshore Wind Turbine must be respecified.

related.title: 風機齒輪箱狀態監測
related.transfer: 可遷移「葉尖速與轉速」與「氣隙公差與結構剛度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；風機齒輪箱狀態監測的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Tip speed and rotor speed" and "Air-gap tolerance and structural stiffness" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Wind Turbine Gearbox Condition Monitoring must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦沒有齒輪箱的發電機：氣隙剪應力與扭矩、極數與頻率、永久磁鐵的用量與氣隙公差；風機齒輪箱狀態監測則以在故障擴大前聽出齒輪箱的問題：總速比、嚙合頻率、軸承缺陷頻率與提早預警的價值為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A generator with no gearbox: air-gap shear stress and torque, poles and frequency, magnet quantity and air-gap tolerance; Wind Turbine Gearbox Condition Monitoring centres on hearing gearbox trouble before it grows: overall ratio, mesh frequency, bearing defect frequencies and the value of early warning, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「掃掠面積與比功率」與「掃掠面積與比功率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「極數與輸出頻率」的模型移到風機齒輪箱狀態監測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「疲勞循環數」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Swept area and specific power" and "Swept area and specific power".
Move the model of "Poles and output frequency" to Wind Turbine Gearbox Condition Monitoring, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Number of fatigue cycles", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「葉尖速與轉速」與「氣隙公差與結構剛度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；風機齒輪箱狀態監測的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Tip speed and rotor speed" and "Air-gap tolerance and structural stiffness" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Wind Turbine Gearbox Condition Monitoring must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 直驅永磁風力發電機
history.titleEn: Direct Drive Permanent Magnet Wind Generators
history.text: 1993 年首款量產的直驅風機問世（採電勵磁）；2008 年永磁直驅風機在中國大量生產；2011 年6 MW 級離岸直驅風機原型安裝；2021 年14 MW 級直驅風機原型安裝。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1993: The first series direct-drive turbine appeared, electrically excited. 2008: Permanent-magnet direct-drive turbines entered volume production in China. 2011: A 6 MW-class offshore direct-drive prototype was installed. 2021: A 14 MW-class direct-drive prototype was installed. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
